caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with a cream or beige background, showing visible folds and slightly frayed edges. Prominently displayed in the center is a large blue flower with layered petals and a green center, supported by a curved brown and yellow stem. Surrounding the blue flower are several botanical elements: leaves shaded in green with yellow and dark accents, various smaller red and pink buds, and a fully bloomed red flower in the bottom left. Sprigs and stems extend outward in different directions, with some leaves featuring a gradient from green to yellow or red. The composition is vertically oriented, and the floral design appears to be embroidered or painted onto the fabric, showcasing vibrant hues of blue, green, red, yellow, and pink against the neutral background.
title: Crewel Embroidered Bed Curtain
